Each simulated family contained independent statistics \(Z_i\sim N(\mu_i,1)\), with \(\mu_i=0\) for nulls and \(\mu_i=2.5\) for nonnulls. One-sided p-values were upper normal-tail probabilities. The executed settings were \(m\in\{20,2000\}\), \(\pi_1\in\{0,0.2\}\), and procedures {uncorrected, BH}; \(\alpha=0.05\). Each setting used 1,537 simulated families and a fixed seed policy based on base seed 20261013.
